units.source_zh: 虽然天空并非万里无云，可已酷热难当了，海风挟着浓重的湿气吹过来，旌旗招展，盔甲哗哗作响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众将明白了布局之后，全军立刻出击。此为辰时左右。到处号角长鸣，人喊马嘶。虽然天空并非万里无云，可已酷热难当了，海风挟着浓重的湿气吹过来，旌旗招展，盔甲哗哗作响。

paragraphs.source_en: Hori Hidemasa’s company formed the leading detachment this time, followed by the left wing, until the highway was filled with men and horses. The common people lining both sides of the road to see them off surely could have felt no ill will toward Hideyoshi.

units.source_en: Hori Hidemasa’s company formed the leading detachment this time, followed by the left wing, until the highway was filled with men and horses.
units.source_zh: 这次的先头部队是堀秀政一行，然后左翼部队跟着出发，官道上全是人马。

units.source_en: The common people lining both sides of the road to see them off surely could have felt no ill will toward Hideyoshi.

ja.t: いてはいなかっただろう。

units.source_zh: 大道两边送行的百姓，大概绝不会对秀吉抱有反感。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这次的先头部队是堀秀政一行，然后左翼部队跟着出发，官道上全是人马。大道两边送行的百姓，大概绝不会对秀吉抱有反感。

paragraphs.source_en: After leaving the farewell crowds behind and reaching the rice fields brimming with rainwater from the rainy season, Hideyoshi raised a hand to his brow and peered back at the right wing following behind. By then his affected ease had vanished, and stern creases had spread across his cheeks.

units.source_en: After leaving the farewell crowds behind and reaching the rice fields brimming with rainwater from the rainy season, Hideyoshi raised a hand to his brow and peered back at the right wing following behind.
units.source_zh: 离开送行的人群，来到梅雨期间贮满了雨水的水田边，秀吉把手搭在额前，张望着跟来的右翼部队。

units.source_en: By then his affected ease had vanished, and stern creases had spread across his cheeks.
units.source_zh: 这时候，故作的轻松已经不见了，冷峻的皱纹爬上了秀吉的面颊。

paragraphs.source_zh: 离开送行的人群，来到梅雨期间贮满了雨水的水田边，秀吉把手搭在额前，张望着跟来的右翼部队。这时候，故作的轻松已经不见了，冷峻的皱纹爬上了秀吉的面颊。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi even indulged in the wild thought that, had Mitsuhide not been branded a traitor, he might lose the will to fight and come to surrender.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi even indulged in the wild thought that, had Mitsuhide not been branded a traitor, he might lose the will to fight and come to surrender.

ja.t: せられていなければ、あるいは
るかもしれない、とまで

units.source_zh: 秀吉甚至异想天开，如光秀的头上没有被冠以逆贼名义，说不定也会失去战斗的意志，前来投降呢。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉甚至异想天开，如光秀的头上没有被冠以逆贼名义，说不定也会失去战斗的意志，前来投降呢。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time they reached Ibaraki, Nakagawa Kiyohide, seemingly still determined to contest the vanguard with Takayama Ukon, had already pressed ahead. Judging from the reports that kept arriving, the Akechi side did not appear fully prepared.

units.source_en: By the time they reached Ibaraki, Nakagawa Kiyohide, seemingly still determined to contest the vanguard with Takayama Ukon, had already pressed ahead.

ja.t: うつもりらしく、すでに

units.source_zh: 到达茨木的时候，中川清秀似还要跟高山右近争夺前锋，已向前进发了。

units.source_en: Judging from the reports that kept arriving, the Akechi side did not appear fully prepared.
units.source_zh: 从不断汇集的情报来看，明智一方的准备似乎并不充分。

paragraphs.source_zh: 到达茨木的时候，中川清秀似还要跟高山右近争夺前锋，已向前进发了。从不断汇集的情报来看，明智一方的准备似乎并不充分。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi drove the great rainbow stretched across the earth steadily onward. That evening, the army camped at Tonda, between Takatsuki and Ibaraki. The moment of decisive battle between the two armies was drawing ever nearer. If they pressed ahead in one unbroken rush, both men and horses would become overly exhausted. Yet that was not the fundamental reason Hideyoshi halted there.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi drove the great rainbow stretched across the earth steadily onward.
units.source_zh: 秀吉指挥着大地上的长虹不断前进。

units.source_en: That evening, the army camped at Tonda, between Takatsuki and Ibaraki.
units.source_zh: 当天晚上，队伍在高规和茨木之间的富田宿营。

units.source_en: The moment of decisive battle between the two armies was drawing ever nearer.
units.source_zh: 两军决战的时刻已经越来越近。

units.source_en: If they pressed ahead in one unbroken rush, both men and horses would become overly exhausted.
units.source_zh: 如果一鼓作气，继续前进，人马就会过于疲劳。

units.source_en: Yet that was not the fundamental reason Hideyoshi halted there.

ja.t: をここにとどまらせた

units.source_zh: 但这些却不是秀吉在这里停留的根本原因。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉指挥着大地上的长虹不断前进。当天晚上，队伍在高规和茨木之间的富田宿营。两军决战的时刻已经越来越近。如果一鼓作气，继续前进，人马就会过于疲劳。但这些却不是秀吉在这里停留的根本原因。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you know why I have halted the troops here tonight?” After camp had been made, Hideyoshi sat beside a fire kindled by his guards and addressed those around him.

units.source_en: “Do you know why I have halted the troops here tonight?”

ja.t: えることにしたか、そなたらには

units.source_zh: “你们知道今晚我为何要在此整顿人马？”

units.source_en: After camp had been made, Hideyoshi sat beside a fire kindled by his guards and addressed those around him.
units.source_zh: 安营扎寨后，秀吉坐在侍卫燃起的火堆旁，对大家道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “你们知道今晚我为何要在此整顿人马？”安营扎寨后，秀吉坐在侍卫燃起的火堆旁，对大家道。

paragraphs.source_en: Gathered around the fire were Hachisuka Hikoemon, Fukushima Ichimatsu, Yamauchi Inoemon, and others, all blinking as they stared at Hideyoshi.

units.source_en: Gathered around the fire were Hachisuka Hikoemon, Fukushima Ichimatsu, Yamauchi Inoemon, and others, all blinking as they stared at Hideyoshi.

ja.t: をしばたたかせながら

units.source_zh: 篝火的周围有蜂须贺彦右卫门，还有福岛市松、山内猪右卫门等，大家都眨着眼睛，看着秀吉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 篝火的周围有蜂须贺彦右卫门，还有福岛市松、山内猪右卫门等，大家都眨着眼睛，看着秀吉。

paragraphs.source_en: “You do not understand, do you?” Before anyone had time to think, Hideyoshi forestalled every answer. “It is because I am showing consideration for the loyal and warmhearted Nobutaka.”

units.source_en: “You do not understand, do you?”
units.source_zh: “不明白吧？”

units.source_en: Before anyone had time to think, Hideyoshi forestalled every answer. “It is because I am showing consideration for the loyal and warmhearted Nobutaka.”
units.source_zh: 还没等大家考虑，秀吉就封住了大家的嘴巴，“这是我体贴有情有义的信孝。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不明白吧？”还没等大家考虑，秀吉就封住了大家的嘴巴，“这是我体贴有情有义的信孝。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh! Is the Lord of Chikuzen waiting here for Nobutaka?” Yamauchi Inoemon asked.

units.source_en: “Oh! Is the Lord of Chikuzen waiting here for Nobutaka?”
units.source_zh: “哦，筑前守是在此等候信孝？”

units.source_en: Yamauchi Inoemon asked.
units.source_zh: 山内猪右卫门问道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦，筑前守是在此等候信孝？”山内猪右卫门问道。

paragraphs.source_en: At once, Ōmura Yūko, who was standing nearby, hurriedly brought out paper and brush. If such loyal and warmhearted words were not carefully recorded now and handed down in glory to posterity, when would there ever be another chance? Yūko had come to regard this as his own mission.

units.source_en: At once, Ōmura Yūko, who was standing nearby, hurriedly brought out paper and brush.
units.source_zh: 这时，一旁的大村幽古慌忙取出了纸笔。

units.source_en: If such loyal and warmhearted words were not carefully recorded now and handed down in glory to posterity, when would there ever be another chance?
units.source_zh: 如此有情有义之言，此时不仔细地记下来让它流芳后世，更待何时！

units.source_en: Yūko had come to regard this as his own mission.
units.source_zh: 幽古已把这看成了自己的使命。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，一旁的大村幽古慌忙取出了纸笔。如此有情有义之言，此时不仔细地记下来让它流芳后世，更待何时！幽古已把这看成了自己的使命。

paragraphs.source_en: Even with a mighty enemy before him, Hideyoshi stole a moment to amuse himself. Whether those words were true or false, whether he was a born liar or an honest man—even Hideyoshi himself could no longer tell.

units.source_en: Even with a mighty enemy before him, Hideyoshi stole a moment to amuse himself.
units.source_zh: 大敌当前的秀吉，又在偷空找乐子。

units.source_en: Whether those words were true or false, whether he was a born liar or an honest man—even Hideyoshi himself could no longer tell.
units.source_zh: 这些话是真是假，他是与生俱来的谎言家还是老实人，甚至连他自己都弄不清楚了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大敌当前的秀吉，又在偷空找乐子。这些话是真是假，他是与生俱来的谎言家还是老实人，甚至连他自己都弄不清楚了。

paragraphs.source_en: It was already midnight, and dark clouds covered the sky. The encamped soldiers lit bonfires one after another, and once again a vast rainbow wound and coiled across the earth.

units.source_en: It was already midnight, and dark clouds covered the sky.
units.source_zh: 已经半夜了，天上乌云笼罩。

units.source_en: The encamped soldiers lit bonfires one after another, and once again a vast rainbow wound and coiled across the earth.
units.source_zh: 野营的人们燃起一堆堆篝火，于是，地上又有了一条巨大的虹在蜿蜒盘旋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 已经半夜了，天上乌云笼罩。野营的人们燃起一堆堆篝火，于是，地上又有了一条巨大的虹在蜿蜒盘旋。
